title: Eva Markets — face-valued Wildcat deposits; live E-U $0, $5.31M is depositor/H-O exposure
closed_reasons: all 3 Wildcat markets are current at the fork block: wmtUSDC/wmtUSDT/wmtWETH isDelinquent=false; USDC/USDT timeDelinquent=0, WETH 11,184 s historic and cured

depositFromMarket() shares = balanceAfter * scaledReceived / scaledAfter = exactly the face value received, but each Eva vault is single-market: face-minted shares are a pro-rata claim on the same market, so existing holders are not diluted
no on-chain venue for impaired wmtUSDC/wmtUSDT/wmtWETH: DexScreener pairs=null, DefiLlama price empty, Curve registry 0 pools — there is no trustless way to buy the tokens at a discount
the vault's only live liquid USDC is $112.998; claimRequest pays from underlying.balanceOf(vault), not from totalAssets/excess; new deposits go straight into the market
a fresh attacker cannot force delinquency: depositing to obtain wmt* adds cash equal to the queue, making the batch payable; only an existing holder exit or a borrower coupon miss triggers it

a 200k exit (8.2% of evaUSDC) already freezes the vault: batch pays $126,379.56, claimRequest reverts (needs full 200k), isDelinquent=true, and queueRequestsBatch reverts ActiveBatchExists until the $73,620 shortfall is repaid
even with a discounted token, the extraction is capped by the market cash ($2,695,448.45 today) and requires a pre-delinquency queue slot; with no venue, realized E-U is $0

one_liner: External unprivileged attacker can extract $0.00 from Eva Markets: depositFromMarket does mark Wildcat tokens at face, but all three $5.31M of markets are current, each vault is a single-market pro-rata pass-through, there is no on-chain venue to buy impaired wmt* tokens at a discount, and the only live liquid balance is $112.998; a 200k exit already freezes the vault, so the $5.31M is depositor/H-O credit exposure to Wintermute, not an outsider payout.
